data.name: Abeden
data.long_meaning: The name Abeden is derived from the Hebrew word ‘abad’, meaning ‘to serve’. In the Bible, there is a figure named Abidan, who is a Levite and a gatekeeper for the Ark of the Covenant. This name is a reminder of the servant's role and dedication to God in the religious community.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abeden is a name of devotion and dedication to God, symbolizing a person's commitment to serving God and following God's will.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Abeden is a 9 Life Path Number, indicating that you are a humanitarian, giving, selfless, and charitable. You are capable of changing the world and can provide comfort to those around you.

data.cultural_impact: The name Abeden symbolizes a commitment to serve in the Christian community, reminiscent of the Levites in the Bible who dedicated their lives to the worship and preservation of God's presence. It evokes an image of sacrifice, dedication, and service, inspiring those with this name to follow in the footsteps of these ancient followers of God.
data.spiritual_significance: Abeden is a name filled with meaning and purpose, as it emphasizes the spiritual importance of serving God. It's a reminder of the call to surrender oneself to the greater purpose of living a life devoted to the Lord. The name Abeden carries a profound sense of humility and selflessness, as well as a deep appreciation for the divine and the sacred.

historical_references.reference: Abednego, Shadrach, and Meshach were three Israelites who were cast into a burning fiery furnace by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, in 586 BCE for refusing to bow down to an image of gold which he had set up.
In the New Testament, Abaddon is a name given to the angel of the Abyss or the pit in the Book of Revelation (11:14-18) and is identified as 'Abaddon, or Abyss, or the Destroyer'.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Abeden continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Abeden, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Abeden meaning "Servant of God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
